summary: RETEST PASS. The web-safe persistImage() fix (Platform.OS==='web' short-circuits FileSystem calls and returns the picker uri) resolves the previous red-screen. Full happy-path was exercised end-to-end on the web preview at 390x844 with data-testid selectors: (1) Create bucket via FAB + bottom sheet works; (2) Tapping bulk-upload-tile opens the browser file chooser and setting 3 png files adds 3 image tiles with NO red-screen; (3) edit-wallpaper-button flips from aria-disabled=true to enabled (aria-disabled attribute removed); (4) /editor/[id] renders editor-canvas with 3 image layers arranged in a mosaic filling the phone-shaped canvas; (5) Top bar shows editor-back-button, save-button, download-button; bottom canvas-toolbar shows tool-mosaic, tool-align-left, tool-align-center, tool-align-right, tool-bg, tool-add-text; (6) tool-bg opens bg-sheet with 10 swatches and selecting one updates canvas background; (7) tool-add-text opens text-sheet, typing + confirm-add-text adds a text layer (canvas items 3->4); (8) tool-mosaic/tool-align-left/center/right all re-arrange without error; (9) Tapping a canvas image switches toolbar to selected-toolbar exposing tool-forward, tool-backward, tool-rotate, tool-duplicate, tool-delete, tool-deselect; tool-delete removed the selected layer (4->3) and reverted to canvas-toolbar; tool-deselect also reverts to canvas-toolbar; (10) save-button completed without crashing; (11) editor-back-button returns to the bucket page. Regression from previous iteration (bucket create + navigation) also works. Non-blocking deprecation warnings persist and one React 19 element.ref console warning was seen.

issues: confirm-create-bucket button reports 'Element is outside of the viewport' at 390x844 (BottomSheet content extends off-screen). Worked around by pressing Enter on the input (onSubmitEditing) but on smaller devices users may not see the Create button without scrolling.

react_native_issues.component: React Native Web deprecated style props
react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'textShadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'textShadow'. Source likely CanvasItem.tsx text styles (textShadowColor/textShadowOffset/textShadowRadius). Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/editor/CanvasItem.tsx:152-155

Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely from BottomSheet's KeyboardAvoidingView pointerEvents='box-none'. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/BottomSheet.tsx

Console error: 'Accessing element.ref was removed in React 19. ref is now a regular prop.' Non-blocking but indicates a dependency still using the legacy ref access pattern. Likely from react-native-view-shot captureRef, moti, or expo-image. No functional impact observed.

action_items: Optional polish: replace textShadow* style props on CanvasItem text with the new 'textShadow' shorthand for RN-Web compatibility.
Optional polish: move pointerEvents from BottomSheet's KeyboardAvoidingView prop into its style prop.

Address confirm-create-bucket viewport overflow on the create-bucket-sheet at compact heights (ensure the primary CTA is inside the visible area, e.g., wrap sheet content in a scroll view or shrink top padding).
critical_code_review_comments: persistImage() web branch is correct; no further web-safety concerns for the offline data layer.
app/editor/[id].tsx captureCanvas uses react-native-view-shot which will fail on web silently (returns null); this is expected env limitation, not a bug.
Console logs one React 19 ref warning from a dependency; verify after any expo/moti/view-shot updates.
seed_data_creation: One bucket 'Editor Test' with 3 tiny red-PNG images uploaded via the web file chooser within a single browser session (localStorage-backed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://photo-layer-compose.preview.emergentagent.com (mobile viewport 390x844). All flows exercised end-to-end. To create a bucket, use the input's Enter key (onSubmitEditing) instead of clicking confirm-create-bucket, since that button can fall below the viewport in the create-bucket-sheet at compact heights. File chooser (page.expect_file_chooser) works for setting picker files on the web preview.
